pipeline.signal_source: flat-region speckle across all 5 pairs (target flat local-var p50 8.2/7.9/11.7/24.4/18.4 vs no-noise sim 0.4/0.0/1.8/19.2/14.8); chroma std +5-20% vs no-noise sim; run_full_analysis flagged GAUSSIAN_YCrCb in all 5 pairs (cross_ch 0.57-0.87); wavelet prior blind to noise->blur (verified 0.00 on noisy sims) so sigma=0 does not rule it out; pair0 statistical CI=10/10 with YCrCb:3 (vs 7/10 with RGB:3)

gm_ratio 0.16-0.50, spectral_slope_ratio 1.20-1.28 in all 5 pairs; severity from gm_ratio calibration against JPEG (target gm_ratio 0.164 ~ gauss3+jpeg 0.143, gauss4 0.104, gauss2 0.227); gaussian beats glass/lens/motion on PSNR at matched settings; glass_score 1.54 is JPEG-inflated (no-blur jpeg5 sim already scores 1.44-1.86)

block_boundary 4.24-7.15 (>>1.05, 0%FP signal) and dct_zero_ratio 0.89-0.95 in all 5 pairs; severity 4 (quality 8) from chroma-std match (target Cr/Cb 7.10/3.74 vs q8 7.47/3.73, q5 9.45/1.40); PSNR grid with ideal affine: gauss3+jpeg4 30.70dB > jpeg5 28.32dB

variance_ratio 0.639-0.734 in all 5 pairs vs 0.90-0.95 for blur+jpeg alone; mean shift follows (1-alpha)*(128-mean) with alpha=0.85-0.90 -> affine contraction toward mid-gray (observed -6.3/+10.0/+7.9/-0.9/-2.5 vs predicted -6.5/+10.1/+8.9/-0.7/-2.3). True alpha~0.88 is milder than any x_distortion contrast severity (mildest 0.75), so library sev1 is the closest; direction strong, severity overshoots

alternatives.reason: noise->blur ordering makes noise subtype only 54.7% identifiable per SKILL; RGB noise is the safe default; flat-var magnitude at pair0 fits stronger pre-blur RGB noise (sev4-5)
if the flat-region speckle is JPEG/chroma artifact rather than an explicit noise step; better PSNR on textured pairs 3/4 (25.69/26.48 vs 23.61/24.39)
measured on variant blur_lens:3,compression_jpeg:5,contrast_weaken_scale:1 (26.24dB, CI 9/10); ideal-affine diagnostic lens3+jpeg4 29.73dB vs gaussian 30.70dB

evidence.noise: present with medium confidence; type unresolvable under noise->blur (SKILL 54.7%); statistical CI 10/10 for YCrCb:3 on pair0
evidence.blur: presence certain (gm_ratio/spectral slope all pairs); subtype gaussian (PSNR) vs glass (confounded DT) vs lens (tied) - UNCERTAIN
evidence.compression: JPEG certain (block_boundary 0%FP); severity 4 (q8) from chroma + PSNR grid
evidence.global: contrast weaken toward mid-gray alpha~0.88; library sev1 (0.75) is closest but overshoots
evidence.ideal_affine_ceiling: with exact alpha=0.88 post-affine, gauss3+jpeg4 reaches 30.70/31.02/30.41/28.00/29.22 dB across pairs 0-4
evidence.qwen_noise_gate: unavailable (no Qwen tool/API found in skill or project)

analysis.note: Pair-level PSNR is suppressed by two irreducible mismatches: (1) true global alpha ~0.88 vs library min 0.75, (2) noise seed. Signal metrics (block boundary 3%, overshoot 1%, zero-crossing 3%, hf/lf 1%) match well.
